sections.content: Several very common verbs have irregular stems in the *pretérito* *indefinido*. Key forms include *fui*, *hice*, *tuve*, *estuve* and *pude*. These forms refer to completed actions just like regular forms. The *tú* form ends in *-iste* and the *nosotros* form in *-imos*: *fuiste*, *fuimos*.

items.english: I was able to try a new food.

sections.content: *Fui* does double duty in this tense: it's the *yo* form of both *ir* and *ser*. *Fui al festival* (I went) and *fui feliz* (I was happy) look identical on the page — only the rest of the sentence tells them apart.
